summary: First run on the Walkthru demo. Backend: 13 of 13 pytest tests pass (contractor, leads list/order, lead detail with scope/quote null and 2 seeded messages, 404s, status PATCH for all 4 values plus invalid->422, message POST with trim, empty->422, bad role->422, unknown lead->404). Frontend (desktop 1920 and mobile 390): the wordmark, the Apex contractor card, stats 3/1/1, 3 rows with badges, row click to /leads/:id, name/type/phone/notes, empty Scope and Quote panels, sending a message (appends, clears input, persists), status selector (persists after reload, shows on the dashboard badge and New stat), the not-found page and the mobile hamburger sidebar all work. No JS page errors. The video element renders with the correct src, but playback could NOT be checked: the test Chromium has no H.264 support (canPlayType avc1 = ''). The video URLs return 200 video/mp4 when fetched with curl (samplelib after a 301 redirect).

minor.issue: Returns null with 200 instead of 404 if the contractor document is missing (only matters if the seed fails).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid 'sidebar-brand-wordmark' appears twice in the DOM (aside + mobile header), which causes a Playwright strict-mode violation. Use a separate id for the mobile header wordmark.

issues: The 'IN REVIEW' status badge wraps onto 2 lines; add whitespace-nowrap to StatusBadge.

action_items: Optional: add a <source type='video/webm'> fallback (e.g. MDN flower.webm) so video plays in browsers without H.264, and use the final samplelib URLs (https://samplelib.com/mp4/...) to skip the 301 redirect
Give the mobile header wordmark its own data-testid
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail: notFound is not reset when leadId changes (setData(null) only). Going from a 404 lead to a valid one via client routing keeps the not-found text visible.
LeadDetail video has no onError fallback UI; a broken URL shows an empty black player.
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ messages were deleted and lead statuses restored to new/in_review/quoted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. The test file's teardown restores statuses and deletes TEST_ messages via direct Mongo. The test Chromium can't decode H.264 MP4s, so don't count video NotSupportedError as an app bug.
rca of the issue: Video NotSupportedError: Playwright's Chromium build ships without proprietary codecs (H.264). It is not an app defect.
